items.reason: Glioblastoma appears only in keywords ('NSCLC; Lung Cancer; Glioblastoma; Endometrial Cancer'); conditions say only 'Advanced Solid Tumors', and the title, inclusion criteria and arm labels never name it. Under C7/D27B a keyword mention does not make glioblastoma eligible, so basket_gbm_eligible is not met.

note: Trial fails S5 (not_glioblastoma), so the priority-3 differences (LCB84 role monotherapy vs combination by arm; target_engagement unclear vs no given 'Mandatory pre- and on-treatment biopsies for enrichment cohorts' with no stated PD endpoint) do not affect analysis; values shown in proposed_final for those are not adjudicated here.
